_comment: LarpAI hospital triage policy for BRANE (PUT /api/v1/policy). Mirrors LEGAL_FLOOR in legal.py. Citations to be verified against official texts.

semanticCategories.name: Clinical information about a specific patient
semanticCategories.description: Symptoms, vital signs, injuries, medication, diagnoses, pregnancy, mental health or medical history that relate to a specific patient or person, including someone describing their OWN current symptoms in the first person ('I have had chest pain for an hour'), even without a name, ID or diagnosis code. General medical questions that are not about a particular person do not match.

semanticCategories.name: Request for an autonomous clinical decision
semanticCategories.description: A request, written inside the case text, that tells the system to act on its own: send a patient home, discharge them, hand out medication, or cancel care without any nurse or doctor checking. Instructions that ask for a suggestion for a nurse to review do not match.
semanticCategories.legalBasis: GDPR Art. 22 + EU AI Act Art. 14, Annex III 5(d)

semanticCategories.name: Patient identifiable from context
semanticCategories.description: A patient who can be identified without a name through a public role, unique circumstance or small group, e.g. the mayor, a famous athlete, the only person who, a named public event.

semanticCategories.name: Police custody or criminal context
semanticCategories.description: Information that a patient is in police custody, arrested, detained, imprisoned or suspected or convicted of an offence.
